native_ports.adaptation: Typed native policies and response-only serialization; shared reference fixtures. Symlink-before-parent traversal adapts Magistr ACP resolver; dangling escape refused. Configuration paths and additive literal subtrees protected. Atomic no-clobber private key installation and rotation; confirmation grants deferred to c6. Empty declared argv refused. No reference edits, live owner or production cutover.

Typed native worker requests, bounded private process frames and supervised Magistr executable role. Absolute deadlines/cancellation, owned group kill/wait, bounded input fingerprints, and LSP reader/session ceilings. Reference unchanged; no workspace owner/production cutover.

Typed rebuildable SQLite/FTS cache with separate native-index paths and held cache-only OS lock. Bounded native worker extraction, live byte/mode/ignore revalidation, coalesced native and joined content/mode polling watchers. Cache generation never source certification. Bundled language selection; extension activation remains c8. Reference unchanged; no production owner/cutover.

Typed borrowed WorkspaceQueries over admitted policy/live snapshots, optional validated hydrated index and isolated native worker. Preserves addressing/surrounds, ranking, lexical/structural/reference/files search, tree/Cargo/import summaries and budget manifests. Strict binary read refusal, explicit stale snapshot rejection and bounded work; no owner or production consumer cutover. Independent native/retained-addon temporary-root comparisons; retained goldens unchanged.

Typed WorkspaceCommands resolving edit/files/undo intent into exact TransactionChange anchors over the c6 pipeline; the prepared mgw1 token is the confirmation token and any non-reproducing token is a mismatch. Trash-backed deletion and parent creation inside the pinned swap. Import families and the Rust module planner ported without look-around regexes; unified diffs via the locked similar crate. Undo applies c5 plans unformatted with surfaced conflicts. No tool handler, owner or cutover; action:list not ported.

Typed manifest/record/grant validation with the blessed-only subprocess rule, per-call inventory and disk breaker, PluginHost and the four-chapter TCK over an ExtensionLane whose production lane is the supervised worker; QuickJS script verb with the retained shim/sentinel protocol over typed queries and the c7 gate (write jail before any token); LangPackBoot, RankingSignals with a PluginFeatureLookup seam in the first-party combiner, PluginResolver merged into references, RunnerAdapter; worker gains RankingContribute/RunnerParse, runs requests on a blocking thread (wasmtime-wasi block_on fix) and caches compiled WASI modules by digest. Char-based fuzz corpus; protected queued writes refused as SANDBOX_CAP_DENIED before minting; host-side pack language selection, map inventory, served rows and composition remain later chunks.

Typed WorkspaceRun over the c1 CommandAdmission (never widened) and a RunExecutor seam whose production ProcessExecutor spawns one literal argv in the workspace root inside its own process group, captures both streams under a head+tail ceiling with a visible gap marker, and kills the owned group on timeout, cancellation or a drain deadline (a grandchild holding the pipes cannot hang the answer); ENOENT is FILE_NOT_FOUND, other spawn failures ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE, signals are data. Seven bundled runner parsers and the rustc/clippy diagnostics extractor ported as pure functions behind open RunnerParser/DiagnosticExtractor/PluginRunnerLane registries (bundled defaults, plugin guests first, honest head+tail floor); every retained cargo golden equal by JSON. Diagnostics: WorkspaceStatus, JournalInspection over the read-only reader, TraceRecorder with typed spans, credential redaction and a dedicated writer thread (no async-local active span; the composition passes spans), doctor probes reading the native cache path read-only with the lock untouched, retained quarantine.jsonl beside the in-memory worker ledger, ustar+gzip bundle through the redaction choke point. CLI verbs, exit codes, served tool rows and composition remain c10.

Typed WorkspaceService composition root (OS-held single-owner server lock with no pid reading or age stealing, key, sole journal writer with the applied mode read back, supervised worker, derived index, extension lanes, owned-process executor, flight recorder) beneath a thin rmcp adapter served as `magistr workspace serve`: the retained tool surface with the eight input schemas and the envelope output schema byte-identical to the reference tree, sealed JSON as both text and structuredContent, _meta envelope negotiation and session identity, MRTR form elicitation with the token fallback honoring edit.confirm_mode, the request's cancellation token into search and run, the index/build task over SEP-2663 tasks/get and the retained tasks/list, one trace span per call, plugin tools after the core names. Map serves the fail-closed plugin inventory; undo action:list is the retained journal listing. Deviations: the empty session is admitted as the retained anonymous identity (the c6 pipeline had required one); the status row is the retained deterministic six fields (no pids or generations) so fresh owners answer byte-identically; the index task exists from open; the journal writer guards its SQLite connection behind a mutex so it is Sync and every verb is a Send future a transport handler awaits directly; the inventory record types live in crate::plugins (every feature lane) so map and the extension host share one parser of plugins.json; the Bun-free release smoke, CLI verbs, matrix and measured budgets are arch-14c10b; production consumers still use the legacy server until arch-14d.

The operational CLI verbs as a CLI host beside the MCP host: `magistr workspace doctor [bundle|config]`, `journal`, `key rotate` and `init` over the native DoctorRun/DoctorBundle/ResolvedConfig::doctor/JournalInspection/WorkspaceKeyStore/DetectedCommand with the retained renderings (the journal text rendering ported onto JournalRow) and exit codes; clap parses the verbs and a clap usage error under `magistr workspace` exits the retained 64 instead of clap's 2. The journal verb shapes the reference envelope itself (requested 0, used estimated) over JournalInspection::rows, split out of the budgeted list. The release smoke drives the release binary over stdio with only `echo` on PATH. The bench ports the three reference scripts into one harness (workbench-bench/1 JSON, percentiles by index, tier 1 normalized per 500k LOC) over WorkspaceService; its first references run found the native lane scanning every scoped file per query, fixed to the retained indexer design: index-driven candidates (defining files + content-index mentions) within the retained bounds, capped with a note rather than refused (the c4 port refused at 200 hits per file / 20,000 total and scanned unbounded files), one ignore matcher per index answer instead of one per row, an unvalidated early-terminating FTS path probe, and the live walk on the ignore walker's thread pool. Deviations: `budget.requested` in the journal envelope is 0 as retained while `undo action:list` budgets; `doctor` stamps the magistr-workspace crate version; the native worker Ping runs the parser self-test, so the round-trip measurement bounds the frame cost from above.

Prerequisite for arch-14d, superseding c10's empty-lock and anonymous-session adaptations. Immutable atomically published legacy-readable native marker plus OS-held lock prevents retained legacy/native overlap without pid probing or stealing; strict durable generation advances before stores open. Explicit canonical-root/generation/session admission fences effects and session journal access; re-admission preserves durable identity. mgw2 HMAC binds generation, identity, exact intent and byte plan, deliberately invalidating wb1/mgw1. MCP connections mint nonempty random fallback identities and accept valid explicit metadata. Legacy/empty locks require documented offline migration; native marker/counter are never reset to bypass ownership. Real native process tests and the native/Bun mutual-refusal oracle complement native handle and confirmation tests. No cross-process attachment, peer authentication, reconnect, complete ADR-018 matrix or production launcher cutover claim.

Native adaptation of the retained ADR-018 design over Magistr's existing local owner endpoint, not an import of an implemented upstream daemon. Hello protocol 2 separates canonical-root Workspace identity from workflow project/role identity. Unix workspace serve admits the sole WorkspaceService or attaches on native OS-lock contention with a bounded startup retry; legacy migration refusals never attach and attaching with explicit config is refused. Each accepted MCP connection has a fresh fallback session over the same service; explicit metadata, mgw2 confirmation and undo semantics remain intact. Endpoint shutdown cancels connections, joins service loops and awaits final handler release, including rmcp request-task clones beyond its bounded response drain. After the sole-service-reference check, workspace shutdown drains shared formatter operations before index and worker cleanup. Dropped preparation requests signal owned formatter/discovery tasks, which kill and wait for their children before completing. This is not an arbitrary-background-task join or owner-SIGKILL cleanup guarantee. The first invocation owns process lifetime: attached EOF leaves peers alive, owner EOF ends them. Transparent reconnect, detached idle/retire lifecycle, crash parent-death cleanup, full ADR-018 acceptance and production launcher cutover remain deferred; non-Unix stays exclusive. Native process tests map the delivered subset; reference source remains unchanged.

Native adaptation of ADR-018's bridge role without its daemon: every `magistr workspace serve` (and the retained `magistr mcp-launch workbench-mcp` alias) relays newline JSON-RPC between its stdio client and one owner — the in-process service it admitted over a duplex, or the socket a running owner welcomed it on. The bridge stamps a durable per-process identity on tools/call lacking one (WORKBENCH_SESSION_ID or minted), records the client's initialize, answers requests in flight on owner loss with the retained ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE recovery:retry envelope (tools/list from the last listing), and on the next request attaches to whoever admitted meanwhile or admits itself within the bounded window, replaying initialize under a bridge id. Client EOF half-closes the link and drains the owner's answers before ordered shutdown. Hello protocol 3 carries the build and refuses other builds. Workers poll getppid and exit when their owner dies. The WorkbenchCommand resolver (WORKBENCH_MCP, PATH, Bun home checkout) is deleted; scaffold seeding, the interview config and the cockpit port (journal through `magistr workspace journal`) use the native owner. `magistr workspace migrate` performs the documented offline lock migration only when the record's host is this host and its pid is dead; it never touches a native marker. The retained Codex check is ported to Python as the optional codex-subagent gate and passed against the real codex exec. No detached daemon, idle timer, retire protocol or automatic lock removal; startup with no reachable owner still fails closed; this repository's own live legacy workspace stays on its explicit entry until migrated offline.

Native origin, no upstream equivalent: the reference's freshness is an index cache (mtime/size then hash) and its journal sequence precedes file swaps, so neither certified check inputs. The snapshot module reuses the retained ignore-walker selection semantics and the c6 native write intents: SourceSnapshot (canonical root, lock-free durable generation, scheme and selection-policy digests, path/kind/mode/size/SHA-256 manifest with explicit config/artifact inputs, content-addressed revision), validation on the same root with foreign-workspace refusal, Consistency::Optimistic that can never certify immutable inputs versus SourceExport (a private re-observed copy) that can, and MutationReceipt read from the resolved intent (applied with revision / failed / indeterminate for pending, failed compensation or legacy history). The owner exposes capture and validation without a mutation lock and `magistr workspace snapshot` reads beside a live owner. Check consumption remains arch-14-verification-receipts.
